text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Goooooooo for it~~!! To the next... 
leveeeeel~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, you're crazy strong!! And here I 
honestly thought we were done for today!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! That's unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that's why I love her, though. 
There's no one else who keeps me on the 
edge of my seat... so thrilled!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy-yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That felt so, so good!! That was totally 
god-tier after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!? Riiight~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You can worship me way more, y'know! Say 
it with me—Goddess Helios~?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Say, Helios, you're so goddamn cute!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Say, Helios, I luuuuv you god-tier style♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, safely made it, so I'm basically a 
god, right? Which meeeans~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Talk about hype, right? Super-duper hype, 
right?? Which means, which means!!
choice_data_list: Ruby will definitely watch me next time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu！！

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rubi-tan, which venue are you performing 
at next!?
choice_data_list: I think it should be the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Yasuda Kinen is one of the Mile G1 
races. Since Daiichi Ruby wants to compete 
on the biggest stages possible, she'll 
definitely run in it."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby's there, right?! Roger that!
choice_data_list: Bamboo Memory will be there too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real!? It's a whole festival!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"After God-tier hype... it's the complete 
opposite, Hell-tier hype!"
choice_data_list: Is that taking it too far the other way?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, we just gotta go for it! Let's do 
this, Yasuda Kinen~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Daitaku Helios visited Kyoto 
Racecourse once more. Her goal, of course, 
was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
PAAARMEEERRR!!! Don't let your vibes get 
beat, yo!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro McQueen! Mejiro McQueen takes the 
lead and crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH!! McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The battle is decided. The winner of this 
year's Tenno Sho (Spring) is the first 
favorite, Mejiro McQueen. Even as the 
crowd erupts into wild cheers—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: PAAARMEEERR!! RUNNNNNN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right up until the moment Mejiro Palmer 
crossed the finish line, Daitaku Helios 
never stopped shouting at the top of her 
lungs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Aww, man! Lost, fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
13th place, huh. Talk about totally 
pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, a fellow Mejiro, took first 
place, and even Ryan made the board.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, here I am... *sigh*, talk about 
the ultimate vibe killer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, is it a turn-off? For some people, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I came in 13th, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I ran my own way, and it's like... "Is 
that it...?" you know?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But you looked super duper cool, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You were running away like crazy! All the 
way to the final corner~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Fr, Palmer was totally in first place way 
longer than McQueen, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I got so hyped & had tons of fun☆ You 
totally slayed out there!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So that's how Palmer runs~ I was like, 
"That's so awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's my bestie for life! Palmer-chin, 
you are so freakin' cool!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Did I really become a true BFF to 
Helios?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hasn't it always been that way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, you're right. That's it!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaagh!!!!! Dammit, I'm so 
frustratedーーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to win with my own style 
of running! I wanted to show you what 
winning looks like~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ah well, it's fine! After all, I ran true 
to who I am!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you know the Kyoto branch of 
Hachimi has matcha flavor? Let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My treat! ☆ To celebrate Palmer-chin 
finishing the Spring Tenno Sho, and to 
cheer me on for the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You go too, Trainy-P!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Helios. My sun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If your light should ever begin to dim... 
that's when."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll definitely be the one to 
light the way—
